items.caption: This drawing represents 頁 in small seal style. The graph’s head sense is analyzed as a kneeling person with the head emphasized; the seal form is described as omitting hair shown in some earlier forms.
items.alt: Black seal-script form of 頁, with a large upper enclosure and several horizontal strokes above a curved lower stroke.
items.selection_reason: The image is legible and identified as a Shuowen seal-style form, and its visible shape can accompany the sourced account of 頁’s head pictograph.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector drawing of a historical script form, not an image of an ancient inscription.
